decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing is a core installation component of the compatible product families the firm has invested in, and the missing 2020-2021 observations are more plausibly a gap in website coverage than evidence of failure, so management persists with it.
Floor-level shower drainage lies at the heart of the firm's announced accessible, low-profile direction, so management will justify continuing the line despite its modest visibility.
As the publicly presented design flagship with heavy investment and visible commitment, the designer shower drain would be the last product management abandons.
The shower element with integrated slope supports the integrated, low-profile bathroom strategy, and weak results can still be put down to pandemic-era disruption in construction and renovation.
The DallSafe 200 basement drain was launched with a specific public announcement and its own page, and growing concern about heavy-rain backflow gives management further reason to stand by it.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral and has had little visibility, but it is cheap to keep and complements the drainage range, so there is no strong pressure to drop it.
